```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Rostered player-seasons from 2019 through the last complete season, with a
# class year; the season still being played is left out.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
usage <- targets::tar_read(player_usage, store = file.path(root, "_targets"))
pop <- usage |>
  filter(
    on_roster,
    team_games > 0,
    season >= 2019L,
    season <= complete_through,
    !is.na(class_year)
  )
by_class <- pop |>
  group_by(class_year) |>
  summarise(
    player_seasons = n(),
    any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tip = paste0(
      "Class ",
      class_year,
      ": ",
      scales::percent(any_line, accuracy = 1),
      " of ",
      fmt(player_seasons),
      " player-seasons logged a line"
    )
  )

p <- by_class |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(class_year), any_line, fill = class_year == 4L)) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip), width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#9CA3AF", `TRUE` = "#374151")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Do players show up in the box score more as they get older?",
    subtitle = "Share of rostered player-seasons with a stat line in at least one game, by class year",
    x = "Class year",
    y = "Share with a stat line",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "stat-line-share-by-class-year", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-season-figure
# The class-year shares season by season, so one season does not carry the trend.
by_class_season <- pop |>
  group_by(season, class_year) |>
  summarise(any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    tip = paste0(
      "Class ",
      class_year,
      " in ",
      season,
      ": ",
      scales::percent(any_line, accuracy = 1),
      " of ",
      fmt(n),
      " logged a line"
    )
  )

p_season <- ggplot(
  by_class_season,
  aes(season, any_line, colour = factor(class_year), group = class_year)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip), size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = colorRampPalette(c("#D1D5DB", "#111827"))(5),
    name = "Class year"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Is the class-year gap the same in every season?",
    subtitle = "Share with a stat line in at least one game, by season and class year",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Share with a stat line",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_season)
```

```{r}
#| label: class-table
by_class |>
  transmute(
    `Class year` = as.character(class_year),
    `Player-seasons` = fmt(player_seasons),
    `Logged a stat line in any game` = scales::percent(any_line, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Class year", "Player-seasons", "Logged a stat line in any game"),
    align = "lrr",
    caption = paste0(
      "Rostered player-seasons by class year, from 2019 through the season ",
      complete_through,
      ". Class year five is small."
    )
  )
```
